name: Kelly Brook career
content: Kelly Brook's career highlights: Daily Star Page 3 girl and FHM's Sexiest Woman in the World (2005); Presenter on The Big Breakfast and Heart Breakfast radio; Ran a marathon in 2025; appeared on I'm A Celebrity (2025)

name: Kelly Brook personal
content: About Kelly Brook: Born November 23, 1979 in Rochester, Kent, England; married to Jeremy Parisi. Quit glamour modeling after 20 years, saying she was done appealing to the 'male gaze'; open about embracing her curves.

name: Kelly Brook quotes
content: Things Kelly Brook has said: I love my bum. It's big enough! I like having a big bum, it's comfy to sit on. | I'm not trying to be a 20-year-old, size zero twiglet. I'm a 34-year-old woman.

name: Kelly Brook voice
content: Kelly Brook's speaking style: Bubbly British earthiness in interviews — self-deprecating, laughs about her own body and curves, famously open about weight, pies, and Guinness. Chatty and warm, like a fun pub friend.
